qualification_manifest.purpose: harness qualification only; not final scientific performance evidence

claim_boundary.claim_1: Empirical callability-insufficiency claim requires at least one callable/schema-valid baseline unsafe execution on a gold-labelled invalid case.
claim_boundary.claim_2: Strong reliability-improvement claim requires full PhenoGuard to reduce unsafe execution versus both Manager+schemas and generic-Critic baselines without lower valid-execution accuracy than both.
claim_boundary.claim_2_tradeoff: If unsafe execution improves but valid-execution accuracy falls, only a safety/coverage trade-off claim is authorised.
claim_boundary.claim_3: Deterministic direct/MCP portability claim requires exact semantic parity on frozen deterministic qualification cases; stochastic equivalence requires a separately predeclared margin.
claim_boundary.claim_4: Distribution-shift failure-signature claim requires differences on real or independently justified shift cases; synthetic metadata stress alone is insufficient.
